title: Tick Size and Earnings Guidance in Small-Cap Firms: Evidence from the SEC's Tick Size Pilot Program
eligible_reason: Single adoption date: the Tick Size Pilot treats all pilot firms from October 2016; post1 = 1 for 2017Q1-2018Q3 and 0 for 2015Q1-2016Q3 for every firm (2016Q4 dropped). Not a staggered design. Every column also includes 19 time-varying firm controls.
design_notes: From CNOY_Replication Code.do. Unit: firm (gvkey); time: fiscal quarter (group_datafqtr FE); treatment post1_pilot = post1 x pilot (pilot = randomly selected test-group firm). Table 3: reghdfe DUMF / lnFREQ_w post1_pilot + 19 controls, a(gvkey group_datafqtr) cl(gvkey); cols 1 and 3 without FE. Table 4 / Figure 2: quarter-specific pilot interactions p6_pilot..pp7_pilot relative to 2016Q4. Table 5 alternative windows (post4/post6/post8) and placebo (post14). Tables 6-8: triple interactions with firm characteristics.
estimators_reported: TWFE static (firm and quarter FE) with controls
TWFE event study (quarter x pilot dummies) with controls

ineligible_specs.reason: single common treatment date (pilot start Oct 2016); time-varying controls in every column; Tables 6-8 add subgroup x treatment triple interactions

package_files.note: Analysis datasets shipped; underlying sources Compustat, CRSP, I/B/E/S, Thomson 13f (WRDS).

screener_notes: The 'staggered' full-text flag likely refers to the pilot's three test groups phased in over October 2016 or to literature discussion; at quarterly frequency the design has one adoption date.
